title: Every Orb Counts
description: A simple mod that adds craftable EXP storage crystals.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa1abfcec19f374b52f3f769eeefb6c1ccd506dd.png)
# What is "Every Orb Counts"?

Every Orb Counts is a mod for Minecraft which adds portable exp storage crystals where you can store your hard earned xp

All of the recipes are based around using the famous but yet mostly underused emerald ore.

You can combine each of the crystals with an ender pearl to create the "thirsty" variant. thirsty crystals automatically store exp orbs you pick up letting you bank your xp on the go.

# How do I craft them?

Ender

![Ender](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fde7fcb1c0de37ef3eb142fa427653a039990a1.png)

# More Info

Each tier allows you to store more exp inside these crystals the final tier allowing you to store 100s of levels

The mod is small and fits well into the vanilla game.
